title: Firefox 158 adds CSS typed arithmetic; a look back at Claude Haiku 5.5
summary: Firefox’s October 13 release expands CSS calculations and Android accessibility. Also revisited: Anthropic’s October 7 launch of a smaller model with adjustable effort.
imageAlt: A browser layout with proportional blocks beside a model chip with an effort slider
imageCaption: Original illustration of proportional layout and adjustable model effort, not a product screenshot.

sections.heading: CSS can calculate ratios between lengths
paragraphs: Firefox 158, released October 13, supports CSS typed arithmetic: dividing compatible values can produce a unitless ratio for further calculations. The release also brings aria-busy support to Firefox for Android, helping assistive technology wait for content updates to finish.

For interfaces that refresh several elements together, this is a useful accessibility detail to test. Layout calculations still need fallbacks for older browsers; a new Firefox release alone does not establish support across an application’s entire browser matrix.

sections.heading: Haiku gets an effort setting
paragraphs: In a seven-day lookback, Anthropic’s October 7 announcement introduced Claude Haiku 5.5 with adjustable effort. The company positions it for narrower, frequent tasks such as summarization and classification, while recommending larger models for complex agentic coding.

For application teams, the useful question is whether a smaller model meets a specific task’s quality target. Compare completion quality, latency and total cost on representative requests before switching; the announcement’s performance claims are vendor results, not a guarantee for every workload.

zh-TW.title: Firefox 158 支援 CSS 型別運算，回顧 Claude Haiku 5.5 的運算投入設定
zh-TW.summary: Firefox 10 月 13 日的更新擴充 CSS 計算與 Android 無障礙支援；同時回顧 Anthropic 10 月 7 日推出、可調整運算投入程度的小型模型。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 以比例區塊組成的瀏覽器版面，旁邊是附有運算投入滑桿的模型晶片
zh-TW.imageCaption: 以比例版面與模型運算投入為題的原創插畫，並非產品截圖。

sections.heading: CSS 可以直接計算長度之間的比例
paragraphs: 10 月 13 日發布的 Firefox 158 支援 CSS 型別運算，讓相容的數值相除後產生無單位比例，再用於其他計算。這次也在 Android 版加入 aria-busy 支援，讓輔助科技能等待內容更新完成後再通知使用者。
對會同時更新多個元素的介面，這是值得實測的無障礙細節。至於新版面計算，仍應替舊瀏覽器保留替代寫法；Firefox 的單次更新，不代表應用程式需要支援的所有瀏覽器都已具備相同能力。

sections.heading: Haiku 也能調整運算投入程度
paragraphs: 回顧最近七天，Anthropic 在 10 月 7 日發布 Claude Haiku 5.5，加入可調整的 effort 設定。官方將它定位於摘要、分類等範圍明確且頻繁執行的任務，複雜的代理式程式開發則仍建議使用較大的模型。
對應用程式團隊，更值得問的是：小型模型是否已達到特定任務的品質門檻？建議先用具代表性的請求比較完成品質、延遲與總成本，再決定是否切換。公告中的效能主張來自廠商評估，並不保證所有工作負載都有同樣結果。
